cards.title: Savitzky-Golay 平滑
cards.keywords: noise smoothing denoise 噪声 降噪 平滑 sg savitzky golay
cards.summary_zh: 通过局部多项式窗口计算 Savitzky-Golay 滤波。窗口必须为奇数，多项式阶数必须小于窗口长度。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目用有限窗口比较降噪与峰形保留；搜索值是项目策略，不是官方最优范围。没有光谱轴时按索引处理，无法确认物理间隔；非等间距轴不自动使用。
cards.applicability_zh: 有高频噪声、希望保留宽吸收带形状的光谱，可在校准数据上比较不同窗口。
cards.limitations_zh: 窗口过大会削弱窄峰；已知非等间距轴不自动采用。平滑不能修复错误标签或分区泄漏。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 官方要求奇数窗口且多项式阶数小于窗口。项目窗口范围 5–15、阶数 1–4；7/11/15 是候选值，不是官方最优范围。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.smooth.SavitzkyGolayFilter(window_length: int = 3, polyorder: int = 1, mode: Literal['mirror', 'constant', 'nearest', 'wrap', 'interp'] = 'nearest', axis: int = 1, window_size='deprecated', polynomial_order='deprecated')

source_documented_parameters.window_length: (int, optional) – The size of the window to use for the Savitzky-Golay filter. Must be odd. Default is 3.
source_documented_parameters.polyorder: (int, optional) – The order of the polynomial to use for the Savitzky-Golay filter. Must be less than window_length. Default is 1.
source_documented_parameters.mode: (str, optional) – The mode to use for the Savitzky-Golay filter. Can be “nearest”, “constant”, “wrap”, “mirror” or “interp”. Default is “nearest”.
source_documented_parameters.axis: (int, optional) – Axis along which the filter is applied. Default is 1 (feature axis).

cards.title: Whittaker 平滑
cards.keywords: noise smoothing denoise 噪声 降噪 平滑 whittaker
cards.summary_zh: 惩罚最小二乘平滑在信号保真和二阶差分平滑约束之间折中；较大的 lam 产生更平滑的趋势。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目将其作为有限降噪候选；过度平滑可能损失窄峰。参数通过校准内部交叉验证比较，不直接采用文档默认值作为最优值。
cards.applicability_zh: 沿变量索引变化平滑、叠加高频噪声的光谱可比较惩罚平滑。
cards.limitations_zh: 惩罚过强会压平峰；本项目对已知非等间距轴不自动采用。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: lambda_ 越大平滑惩罚越强；项目合法范围 1–1e10，当前内置卡片比较 1e3/1e4。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.smooth.WhittakerSmooth(lam: float = 10000.0, weights: ndarray | None = None, solver_type: Literal['banded', 'sparse'] = 'banded', n_jobs: int = 1)

source_documented_parameters.lam: (float, default=1e4) – Regularization parameter controlling smoothness of the fitted signal. Larger values yield smoother trends.
source_documented_parameters.weights: (ndarray of shape (n_features,), optional, default=None) – Non-negative weights applied to each observation. If None, all observations are weighted equally.
source_documented_parameters.solver_type: (Literal["banded", "sparse"], default="banded") – Backend used to solve the Whittaker linear system. Prefer "banded" (the default): it solves all rows in a single batched LAPACK call and is roughly 27× faster than "sparse" at scale. Use "sparse" only as a numerical fallback for ill-conditioned problems.
source_documented_parameters.n_jobs: (int, default=1) – Number of parallel jobs used during transform(). Only effective when solver_type="sparse": rows are split across workers via joblib. When solver_type="banded" (the default), a single vectorised LAPACK batch solve is used regardless of this value, because it is already faster than spawning parallel workers. With solver_type="sparse" and n_jobs=-1, benchmarks show roughly 4× speedup on 8 cores.

cards.title: SNV 标准正态变量
cards.keywords: scatter multiplicative normalization 散射 乘性 标准化 snv
cards.summary_zh: 按每条光谱的均值和标准差计算标准正态变量，无构造超参数；平坦光谱的零标准差会导致数值问题。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目将其用于散射变化候选；整体幅度可能包含目标信息，应与原始光谱对照比较。
cards.applicability_zh: 样本之间存在加性或乘性散射差异时，可比较逐谱均值与标准差校正。
cards.limitations_zh: 异常波段会影响均值和标准差；可能移除与浓度有关的整体强度信息。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 没有可编辑运行时参数；本项目使用已验证的 Chemotools 提供者。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.scatter.StandardNormalVariate

cards.title: MSC 乘性散射校正
cards.keywords: scatter multiplicative additive reference 散射 乘性 加性 参考谱 msc
cards.summary_zh: 针对参考谱进行线性回归，校正加性与乘性散射。未指定参考谱时，可由训练光谱均值或中位数估计。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目仅从校准数据拟合参考谱，并在交叉验证每一折重新拟合；运行时封装只提供默认参考策略，不开放官网的全部参数。
cards.applicability_zh: 样本散射变化可用训练参考谱的线性关系解释时可比较 MSC。
cards.limitations_zh: 参考谱必须在训练边界拟合；不能用全数据参考谱校正后再划分验证。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 普通流水线无公开调参字段；训练参考谱由当前训练折拟合并在验证/预测中复用。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.scatter.MultiplicativeScatterCorrection(method: Literal['mean', 'median'] = 'mean', reference: ndarray | None = None, weights: ndarray | None = None)

source_documented_parameters.method: ({"mean", "median"}, default="mean") – The statistic used to calculate the reference spectrum if reference is None. - “mean”: Use the average spectrum of the training set. - “median”: Use the median spectrum of the training set.
source_documented_parameters.reference: (array-like of shape (n_features,), default=None) – A custom reference spectrum to use for the correction. If provided, method is ignored.
source_documented_parameters.weights: (array-like of shape (n_features,), default=None) – Weighting vector applied during the linear regression for each spectrum. Useful for de-emphasizing noisy wavelengths.

cards.title: AsLS 非对称最小二乘基线校正
cards.keywords: baseline drift asymmetric correction 基线 漂移 背景 校正 asls
cards.summary_zh: 以非对称权重迭代估计平滑基线。lam 控制平滑程度；文档建议 penalty 在 0.001 至 0.1 之间。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 候选值是项目有限搜索策略；宽吸收带可能被当作基线去除，应通过训练内部验证确认收益。
cards.applicability_zh: 谱峰叠加在缓慢变化背景上时可比较非对称最小二乘基线估计。
cards.limitations_zh: 参数依赖采样密度与谱峰方向；负向谱峰或宽峰会改变基线估计，应验证是否移除有效信号。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: lambda_ 映射官方 lam，p 映射 penalty。项目范围 lambda_=1e3–1e8、p=0.001–0.999；候选不是官方最优设置。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.baseline.AsLs(lam: float = 10000.0, penalty: float = 0.01, nr_iterations: int = 100, solver_type: Literal['banded', 'sparse'] = 'banded', max_iter_after_warmstart: int = 20, n_jobs: int = 1)

source_documented_parameters.lam: (float, default=1e4) – Regularization parameter controlling smoothness of the baseline. Larger values yield smoother baselines.
source_documented_parameters.penalty: (float, default=0.01) – The asymmetry parameter. It is recommended to set between 0.001 and 0.1 [1]
source_documented_parameters.nr_iterations: (int, default=100) – Maximum number of reweighting iterations.
source_documented_parameters.solver_type: (Literal["banded", "sparse"], default="banded") – Backend used to solve the Whittaker linear system. Prefer "banded" (the default): it exploits the pentadiagonal structure of \(D^T D\) with an O(n_features) LAPACK solve and is consistently faster. Use "sparse" only as a numerical fallback for ill-conditioned problems.
source_documented_parameters.max_iter_after_warmstart: (int, default=20) – Maximum iterations allowed when warm-starting from previous weights.
source_documented_parameters.n_jobs: (int, default=1) – Number of parallel jobs used during transform(). Effective for both solver types because each sample is processed independently through the iteration loop. Benchmarks show roughly 4–5× speedup with n_jobs=-1 on 8 cores.

cards.title: 多项式去趋势
cards.keywords: baseline drift polynomial detrend 基线 漂移 多项式 去趋势
cards.summary_zh: 拟合并减去多项式基线；未指定 indices 时使用所有变量。官方接口支持阶数和基线点索引。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目 detrend 封装固定为二次多项式，不能把官方 order 或 indices 直接传入。默认按等间距索引拟合，宽峰信息可能受影响。
cards.applicability_zh: 以低阶平滑趋势为主的基线漂移可比较多项式去趋势。
cards.limitations_zh: 宽吸收带可能被当作基线；本项目实现固定多项式策略且要求规则轴，不在卡片中开放任意阶数。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 本项目普通方法无可编辑参数；官方 PolynomialCorrection 的其他参数不等于本流水线接口。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.baseline.PolynomialCorrection(order: int = 1, indices: list | None = None)

source_documented_parameters.order: (int, optional, default=1) – The order of the polynomial to fit to the baseline. Defaults to 1.
source_documented_parameters.indices: (list, optional, default=None) – The indices of the points in the spectrum to fit the polynomial to. Defaults to None, which fits the polynomial to all points in the spectrum (equivalent to detrend).

cards.title: AirPLS 自适应基线校正
cards.keywords: baseline adaptive correction 基线 漂移 自适应 校正 airpls
cards.summary_zh: 迭代调整残差权重并估计平滑基线，lam 控制平滑强度，nr_iterations 限制迭代次数。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目优先在扩展预算中比较；宽吸收峰和异常背景需要复核，状态拟合严格限制在训练边界内。
cards.applicability_zh: 缓慢变化背景和谱峰分离较明显时可比较自适应重加权惩罚基线。
cards.limitations_zh: 迭代收敛和峰保留须在校准数据验证；可能误扣宽谱带。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 公开参数 lambda_=1e3–1e8、porder=1–3、max_iters=1–1000；名称由项目适配器映射至 Chemotools。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.baseline.AirPls(lam: float = 10000.0, nr_iterations: int = 100, solver_type: Literal['banded', 'sparse'] = 'banded', max_iter_after_warmstart: int = 20, n_jobs: int = 1)

source_documented_parameters.lam: (float, default=1e4) – Regularization parameter controlling smoothness of the baseline. Larger values yield smoother baselines.
source_documented_parameters.nr_iterations: (int, default=100) – Maximum number of reweighting iterations.
source_documented_parameters.solver_type: (Literal["banded", "sparse"], default="banded") – Backend used to solve the Whittaker linear system. Prefer "banded" (the default): it exploits the pentadiagonal structure of \(D^T D\) with an O(n_features) LAPACK solve and is consistently faster. Use "sparse" only as a numerical fallback for ill-conditioned problems.
source_documented_parameters.max_iter_after_warmstart: (int, default=20) – Maximum iterations allowed when warm-starting from previous weights.
source_documented_parameters.n_jobs: (int, default=1) – Number of parallel jobs used during transform(). Effective for both solver types because each sample is processed independently through the iteration loop. Benchmarks show roughly 4–5× speedup with n_jobs=-1 on 8 cores.

cards.title: ArPLS 自适应重加权基线校正
cards.keywords: baseline reweighted correction 基线 漂移 重加权 校正 arpls
cards.summary_zh: 通过重加权惩罚最小二乘估计平滑基线；lam 控制平滑程度，ratio 是权重更新的收敛阈值。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目优先在扩展预算中比较，结果仍需校准内部交叉验证确认。
cards.applicability_zh: 需要迭代重加权估计背景时可与 AsLS、AirPLS 比较。
cards.limitations_zh: 不能保证适合所有吸收/反射谱；基线扣除后应检查残差与有效峰。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: lambda_=1–1e10、ratio=1e-6–1、max_iters=1–1000 为项目约束；更大惩罚改变背景平滑程度。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.baseline.ArPls(lam: float = 10000.0, ratio: float = 0.01, nr_iterations: int = 100, solver_type: Literal['banded', 'sparse'] = 'banded', max_iter_after_warmstart: int = 20, n_jobs: int = 1)

source_documented_parameters.lam: (float, default=1e4) – Regularization parameter controlling smoothness of the baseline. Larger values yield smoother baselines.
source_documented_parameters.ratio: (float, default=0.01) – Convergence threshold for weight updates.
source_documented_parameters.nr_iterations: (int, default=100) – Maximum number of reweighting iterations.
source_documented_parameters.solver_type: (Literal["banded", "sparse"], default="banded") – Backend used to solve the Whittaker linear system. Prefer "banded" (the default): it exploits the pentadiagonal structure of \(D^T D\) with an O(n_features) LAPACK solve and is consistently faster. Use "sparse" only as a numerical fallback for ill-conditioned problems.
source_documented_parameters.max_iter_after_warmstart: (int, default=20) – Maximum iterations allowed when warm-starting from previous weights.
source_documented_parameters.n_jobs: (int, default=1) – Number of parallel jobs used during transform(). Effective for both solver types because each sample is processed independently through the iteration loop. Benchmarks show roughly 4–5× speedup with n_jobs=-1 on 8 cores.

cards.title: RNV 稳健正态变量
cards.keywords: scatter robust percentile 散射 稳健 分位数 rnv
cards.summary_zh: 计算稳健正态变量；percentile 指定分位数且应在 0 至 100 之间，epsilon 用于避免除零不稳定。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目将其作为扩展预算的稳健散射候选，不能仅凭检索声称优于 SNV 或 MSC。
cards.applicability_zh: 散射变化伴有重尾噪声或异常波段时可比较分位数稳健标准化。
cards.limitations_zh: RNV 的分位数策略与本项目中位数/MAD 稳健 SNV 不同；不能把二者当作同一算法。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: percentile=0–100，epsilon=1e-15–1；当前内置卡片使用分位数 25 作为比较起点，不代表官方最优值。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.scatter.RobustNormalVariate(percentile: float = 25, epsilon: float = 1e-10, n_jobs: int = 1)

source_documented_parameters.percentile: (float, optional, default=25) – The percentile to use for the robust normal variate. The value should be between 0 and 100. The default is 25.
source_documented_parameters.epsilon: (float, optional, default=1e-10) – A small value added to the denominator to avoid numerical instability (division by zero). The default is 1e-10.
source_documented_parameters.n_jobs: (int, optional, default=1) – Number of parallel jobs used to process samples independently. Uses serial execution when set to 1.

cards.title: Savitzky-Golay 一阶导数
cards.keywords: derivative baseline overlapping peaks 导数 基线 重叠峰 savitzky golay
cards.summary_zh: 用 Savitzky-Golay 局部多项式计算导数；窗口需为奇数，阶数小于窗口，deriv 控制导数阶数。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目避免低信噪比时自动求导，因其可能放大噪声；索引导数不能声称是有物理单位的光谱轴导数。
cards.applicability_zh: 基线漂移或宽峰重叠时可比较一阶导数，需先确认噪声水平与光谱轴。
cards.limitations_zh: 求导可能放大噪声；低信噪比禁用自动候选。索引导数不具有已确认的物理轴单位。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: window=5–15 且奇数，order=1–4 且小于窗口；spacing_mode=index/wavelength。物理轴模式须通过实际轴校验。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.derivative.SavitzkyGolay(window_length: int = 3, polyorder: int = 1, deriv: int = 1, mode: Literal['mirror', 'constant', 'nearest', 'wrap', 'interp'] = 'nearest', window_size='deprecated', polynomial_order='deprecated', derivate_order='deprecated')

source_documented_parameters.window_length: (int, optional, default=3) – The size of the window to use for the derivative calculation. Must be odd. Default is 3.
source_documented_parameters.polyorder: (int, optional, default=1) – The order of the polynomial to use for the derivative calculation. Must be less than window_length. Default is 1.
source_documented_parameters.deriv: (int, optional, default=1) – The order of the derivative to calculate. Default is 1.
source_documented_parameters.mode: (str, optional, default="nearest") – The mode to use for the derivative calculation. Can be “nearest”, “constant”, “wrap”, “mirror” or “interp”. Default is “nearest”.

cards.title: EMSC 扩展乘性散射校正
cards.keywords: emsc scatter nonlinear interference 扩展 散射 非线性 干扰
cards.summary_zh: 拟合多项式基线、参考谱及可选干扰谱，校正散射与基线变化。官方支持参考谱、干扰谱和波长权重。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 本项目将 EMSC 保留为显式选择方法，检索命中不会自动执行，也不会假设已知干扰谱。
cards.applicability_zh: 已明确散射及基线校正需求时，可显式比较包含多项式项的参考谱校正。
cards.limitations_zh: 本项目仅显式选择；不假设用户已提供干扰谱。官方完整 EMSC 功能不等于本项目公开接口。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 正确项目参数为 polynomial_order=0–3、method=mean/median、min_multiplicative=1e-15–1；polynomial_order 映射官方 order。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.scatter.ExtendedMultiplicativeScatterCorrection(method: Literal['mean', 'median'] = 'mean', order: int = 2, reference: ndarray | None = None, interferences: ndarray | None = None, weights: ndarray | None = None)

source_documented_parameters.method: ({"mean", "median"}, default="mean") – The statistic used to calculate the reference spectrum if reference is None.
source_documented_parameters.order: (int, default=2) – The order of the polynomial baseline. 0 is a constant offset, 1 is linear, 2 is quadratic, etc.
source_documented_parameters.reference: (array-like of shape (n_features,), default=None) – A custom reference spectrum. If provided, method is ignored.
source_documented_parameters.interferences: (array-like of shape (n_interferences, n_features), default=None) – Known spectra of chemical interferents (e.g., water, CO2) to be mathematically removed from the signal.
source_documented_parameters.weights: (array-like of shape (n_features,), default=None) – Wavelength weights for Weighted EMSC. Useful for de-emphasizing noisy regions of the spectrum.

cards.title: 稳健 SNV（中位数/MAD）
cards.keywords: robust snv median mad 稳健SNV 中位数 重尾 异常波段
cards.summary_zh: 项目自有实现：逐谱使用中位数和 MAD 替代均值与标准差。来源链接解释 MAD 原语，不是本方法的官方文档。
cards.applicability_zh: 散射变化伴随异常波段或重尾噪声，可显式比较稳健尺度估计。
cards.limitations_zh: 不等同于 Chemotools RNV；MAD 接近零或大范围污染时需检查结果。仅显式选择。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: consistency 的项目默认值 1.4826、合法范围 1e-12–10；来源中的 MAD scale 与本参数并非同名接口。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 项目适用建议须通过训练内验证；不能据卡片宣称特定光谱类型必然适用。

cards.title: 孤立尖峰去除
cards.keywords: despike spike isolated 孤立尖峰 去尖峰 仪器 脉冲
cards.summary_zh: 项目自有实现：局部中值参考加稳健残差阈值，只替换被判定的孤立尖峰。SciPy 来源仅说明中值滤波原语。
cards.applicability_zh: 出现稀疏仪器尖峰且其形状可与有效吸收峰区分时显式使用。
cards.limitations_zh: 阈值过小可能删除真实窄峰；不同于对整条谱执行中值滤波。仅显式选择。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: window=3–51 且奇数，z_threshold=2–20；窗口和阈值必须通过实际峰形检查及训练内验证。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 项目适用建议须通过训练内验证；不能据卡片宣称特定光谱类型必然适用。

cards.title: 中值滤波
cards.keywords: median filter smoothing 中值滤波 脉冲 尖峰
cards.summary_zh: 对局部窗口取中值，降低脉冲噪声；会对整条谱执行滤波。
cards.applicability_zh: 密集脉冲噪声可显式比较小窗口中值滤波。
cards.limitations_zh: 可能削弱窄吸收峰；仅显式选择。本项目对已知非等间距轴不自动推荐。
cards.parameter_guidance_zh: 本项目 window_length=1–51 且奇数，mode 默认 nearest。官网部分版本称 window_size，当前安装提供者由适配器使用 window_length。
cards.planning_notes_zh: 项目适用建议须通过训练内验证；不能据卡片宣称特定光谱类型必然适用。
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.smooth.MedianFilter(window_length: int = 3, mode: Literal['reflect', 'constant', 'nearest', 'mirror', 'wrap', 'grid-constant', 'grid-mirror', 'grid-wrap'] = 'nearest', n_jobs: int = 1, window_size='deprecated')

cards.title: Ridge 岭回归
cards.keywords: ridge l2 regression 岭回归 正则化 共线 高维 线性

cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.scale.BandScaler(start: int = 0, end: int = -1, x_axis: ndarray | None = None, aggregation: str = 'mean', baseline_correction: bool = False, wavenumbers='deprecated')

source_documented_parameters.start: (int, default=0) – Index or x-axis value of the start of the range.
source_documented_parameters.end: (int, default=-1) – Index or x-axis value of the end of the range.
source_documented_parameters.x_axis: (array-like, optional) – X-axis values corresponding to columns. Must be ascending if provided.
source_documented_parameters.aggregation: ({'mean', 'area'}, default='mean') – The aggregation method to use for calculating the band intensity. - ‘mean’: Calculate the mean intensity of the band. - ‘area’: Calculate the area under the band using the trapezoidal rule.
source_documented_parameters.baseline_correction: (bool, default=False) – If True, a linear baseline connecting the band endpoints is subtracted from the band before computing the scaling factor. This removes the effect of a sloped baseline on the mean or area calculation.
source_documented_parameters.wavenumbers: (array-like, optional) – Deprecated alias for x_axis. Use x_axis instead.

cards.title: 改进 sinc 平滑 · ModifiedSincFilter
cards.source_documented_signature: class chemotools.smooth.ModifiedSincFilter(window_length: int = 21, n: int = 6, alpha: float = 4.0, use_corrections: bool = True, mode: Literal['mirror', 'constant', 'nearest', 'wrap', 'interp'] = 'interp', axis: int = 1, window_size='deprecated')

source_documented_parameters.window_length: (int, default=21) – Odd number of taps (2*m + 1). Larger values give stronger smoothing.
source_documented_parameters.n: (int, default=6) – Even integer >= 2. Controls how many inner zeros the sinc has within the window. The paper discusses n = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 (Fig. 2).
source_documented_parameters.alpha: (float, default=4.0) – Positive window width parameter. Larger alpha reduces side lobes more aggressively (steeper roll-off).
source_documented_parameters.use_corrections: (bool, default=True) – If True and n in {6, 8, 10} and the window is large enough, add the small passband-flattening terms from Eqs. 7–8 (coefficients from Table 1).
source_documented_parameters.mode: ({"mirror", "constant", "nearest", "wrap", "interp"}, default="interp") – Boundary strategy, passed to the base FIR class. “interp” performs linear extrapolation (recommended in the paper).
source_documented_parameters.axis: (int, default=1) – Axis along which to smooth for 2D inputs (rows x features). Use 1 to smooth within each row.
